## Possible duplicates

Two kinds of hit. Neither is automatically a bug — read before acting.

### Cross-layer — a shared value rebuilt locally (14)

The same name exists in a shared home AND somewhere else. Import the shared
one; delete the local copy. These are the real hits.

| Name | Exported from |
| --- | --- |
| `cancelSubscriptionAction` | **`@/lib/services/main/portal.api`**, **`@/lib/services/main/subscription.api`** |
| `clearCartAction` | **`@/lib/services/main/cart.api`**, **`@/lib/services/main/product.api`** |
| `getCartAction` | **`@/lib/services/main/cart.api`**, **`@/lib/services/main/product.api`** |
| `getInvoicesAction` | **`@/lib/services/main/ecommerce.api`**, **`@/lib/services/main/portal.api`** |
| `getNotificationsAction` | **`@/lib/services/admin/notifications.service`**, **`@/lib/services/main/community.api`**, **`@/lib/services/main/notification.client`**, **`@/lib/services/main/portal.api`** |
| `inr` | `@/modules/Main/Account/AccountUI`, `@/modules/Main/Plans/helpers`, **`@/utils/formatCurrency`** |
| `MOCK_NOTIFICATIONS` | **`@/constants/community`**, **`@/constants/portalMockData`** |
| `useCancelSubscriptionMutation` | **`@/lib/hooks/main/usePortal`**, **`@/lib/hooks/main/useSubscription`** |
| `useCart` | **`@/lib/hooks/main/useCart`**, **`@/lib/hooks/main/useProduct`** |
